_comment: Optional signed-push mode. When x_fed_day2_ops.sam_jws_public_key is configured, the endpoint prefers the jws claim over a live pull-verify call -- see verifyWithSam() in sam_inbound_ritm.js. approval_authority/risk_tier/access_item/justification in the top-level body are still REQUIRED for validateInboundPush(), but the VERIFIED values used for lineage and the RITM come from the signed claims, not this body -- and verifyJws() must confirm the claims' sam_request_id matches the top-level sam_request_id (signature_subject_mismatch otherwise). The jws string itself is opaque here; it is issued by IIQ/ISC's signer, not authored by hand.
